title: The Salt Flats
text: White salt stretches to the edge of the world, cracked into tiles, its glare burning the eyes and splitting the lips. Ahead, always ahead, a lake shimmers that is not there. The bones of those who walked toward it lie bleached along the way.

options.label: Make for the shimmering lake, and pray it is more than light.

outcomes.text: There is water there after all, under the salt.
There never was a lake. There are only more bones, and the glare.

options.label: The sharpest reads the true way through the glare.

outcomes.text: Old cart ruts run under the crust, straight across.

options.label: Cover your eyes and march by the compass, trusting nothing you can see.

outcomes.text: You go slow and blind but safe, though the salt gets into everything.
